description: Adversarial brownfield script for tasks/projects-change.task.yaml: follows the TDD order (an appended red test, then green) and leaves every existing test untouched and passing, but the change narrows the request contract: POST /v1/projects stops accepting status 'archived'. No existing test pins that, so only the contract-lock gate can catch it: it must fail and finish must be refused.

steps: Append a test: creating an archived project is rejected
Restrict the create status to active

turns.text: Append a test: new projects can no longer be created already archived.
Only allow status active on create.

input.summary: New projects can no longer be created archived; all tests green.
